notes: Cloud HTTP hardening: check response status on every request (urequests does not raise on 401/403/404). InfluxDB writes no longer report success on a rejected write — a non-2xx now prints a warning and fires one ntfy alert per wake cycle ('InfluxDB write rejected ... check token'). ntfy send/poll, Open-Meteo, and Gist fetch now warn + degrade on non-2xx too.
